Two samples of the agent over all 23 evaluation papers, in the two modes the agent was rerun in, against the pipeline on Opus 5.5, which has two samples on all 23 (claims within tolerance of the paper's printed value).  *Agent sample 1* is the row used everywhere else in this report (ROADMAP 3.3, 3.4, 3.6, 3.7); *agent sample 2* is a second Claude Code run (`claude-code-run2-13papers-indep-blind-2026-11-01.json` for the 13 earlier papers, `claude-code-run2-4papers-indep-blind-2026-11-02.json` for the four of ROADMAP 3.6, `claude-code-run2-6papers-indep-blind-2026-11-02.json` for the six of ROADMAP 3.7).  The pipeline samples are those of the table above.  *Cells identical*, *mean* and *max abs. diff* compare the two agent samples cell by cell; the last column is the smallest and largest of the agent-minus-pipeline differences over the four pairings (each agent sample against each pipeline sample).
